title: Slack for event planners on Mac: set up the template, track tasks and manage vendors
metaTitle: Slack for Event Planners on Mac: Template, Tasks and Vendors
description: Set up Slack's event planning template on Mac, track tasks and vendor work in channels, and ask Lazur for help while you work in the app.
targetKeyword: slack for event planners on mac
intro: Slack for event planners on Mac works best with one channel per event. Start with Slack's event planning template, which adds an Event Overview tab, a Task Tracker tab and a status notifications workflow. This page covers that setup, the gaps the template leaves, and the Mac habits that keep a busy event week readable. Lazur can point at things and draft text, but it does not run Slack for you.
tldr: Use Slack's event planning template to get a channel with an Event Overview tab and a Task Tracker tab.
The template has no budget tab, so log budget items in the Task Tracker or the Event Overview.
Free keeps only 90 days of history, so save signed contracts and final budgets outside Slack.
Press ⌘K to jump between channels and ⌘/ to list every keyboard shortcut.
Lazur points at things, guides you one click at a time, dictates and drafts text. It does not click for you.

blocks.text: Most event planners do not need a new tool. They need one place where the venue, the vendors and the team see the same plan. Slack can be that place if you give each event its own channel and keep tasks in one list. This guide covers that setup on a Mac, in the desktop app. It also covers what Slack does not handle, such as budgets, and the habits that stop a busy event week from turning into a pile of unread messages.
Why one channel per event works on a Mac

A channel per event gives every decision a home. Venue questions stay with the venue. Catering talk stays with catering. When someone new joins, they open one channel and read the history. That beats searching a shared inbox for a contract clause late at night.

On a Mac, keep the desktop app open during planning. Slack's help pages build their steps around the desktop app, and the shortcuts in this guide work there. The newest Mac build on Slack's release notes page is 4.53.283, dated November 9, 2026. It is a bug-fix release. Recent entries mention no new menus, so the steps here should match your screen. If a label looks different, check your app version first.
Set up the event planning template in Slack

To find workflow templates on desktop, click Agents & tools in the sidebar. Under Workflows, click Templates. If that item is missing, look for a Tools tab and click More. Some accounts show Tools in place of Agents & tools, so the label may differ for you. Once you find the template, run through these six setup steps.

items: Add the event planning template. Slack creates a preconfigured channel for the event.
Edit the tasks, dates, venues and roles so they match your event.
Complete the Event Overview tab with the agenda, core team, speakers, venue and vendors, sponsors and partners, and marketing plans.
Set up the Task Tracker with a status, priority, description, assignee and due date for each task.
Share the channel in the other channels that need it, such as sales or the venue team.
Turn on reminders and the Item Status Notifications workflow, so the channel hears when a task changes status.

blocks.text: Templates labeled Advanced open in Workflow Builder. There you can edit steps, reorder them and add new ones. Slack says Advanced templates are available on paid plans. Its help article does not say which templates carry the label, so check the label on the template you pick.

Permissions matter too. By default, Full Members can create workflows, and members and guests can use them. If you cannot see the template or cannot create a workflow, the answer depends on your workspace. Ask your workspace admin before you rebuild anything by hand.

blocks.title: Check your plan first
blocks.text: Slack's own limitations page says Free workspaces cannot create new Workflow Builder workflows. Some third-party blogs say Free users can build them. Trust Slack's page. Check your plan before you build an event around a workflow.
What the template covers and what it leaves out

blocks.caption: Parts of Slack's event planning template and what each one holds
rows: Agenda, core team, speakers, venue and vendors, sponsors and partners, marketing plans
The one page everyone reads first
Status, priority, description, assignee and due date for each task
Owning every deliverable and its deadline
Alerts the channel when a tracked task changes status
Knowing a task closed without asking
No dedicated tab. Slack says to log budget items in the other two tabs
Budget lines go in Task Tracker descriptions or the overview

blocks.text: Notice what the template leaves out. There is no budget tab and no contract store. Slack's FAQ says to log vendor details and budget items in the Event Overview and the Task Tracker. That works for a small event with a few line items. For a larger budget, keep a spreadsheet and link to it from the Event Overview. Slack does not say whether canvases fit this template, so test that in a practice channel before you rely on it.
Handle vendors without losing them in the channel

Vendors are where event channels get messy. A caterer, an AV company and a venue each send updates at different times. Put each vendor in its own thread under the main event channel. Start one top-level message per vendor, and keep the replies inside that thread. Your team can then scan a short list of threads instead of the whole channel. The [Threads view](/how-to/open-the-threads-view-in-slack) shows the replies you follow.

Work with outside companies through Slack Connect. A Slack Connect channel can include up to 250 organizations, counting your own. Admins can limit who may invite people from outside. When you invite a vendor, choose Can post & invite or Can only post. Some invitees need admin approval, depending on each company's settings.

blocks.title: Free plan limit
blocks.text: On the Free plan, Slack Connect covers one-to-one work with external partners in DMs. A group vendor channel needs a paid plan. Check the plans table before you invite the whole vendor list.

Keep signed contracts and final invoices out of Slack alone. Free workspaces keep the most recent 90 days of message and file history. Data more than one year old is deleted. Save the signed PDF in a folder you control, then link to it from the channel.
Keyboard shortcuts that save time during event week

Two shortcuts cover most of the navigation. ⌘K opens the quick switcher, so you can jump to a channel or a person without touching the sidebar. ⌘/ shows the full list of keyboard shortcuts in the desktop app. Open that list once on the first day. Then check it when you need a shortcut you have not learned yet.

items: Press ⌘K, type the first letters of the vendor channel, then press Return.
Press ⌘/ when you forget a shortcut, instead of hunting through menus.
Open the main event channel first each morning, then the vendor threads, so the day starts in the same place.
Use search inside a channel when you know the conversation, and workspace search when you do not.

blocks.text: For the step-by-step versions, read [how to show the keyboard shortcuts list in Slack on Mac](/how-to/show-the-keyboard-shortcuts-list-in-slack) and [how to jump to a conversation in Slack on Mac](/how-to/jump-to-a-conversation-in-slack).
Cut notification noise before load-in day

Notifications are the most-cited complaint in G2's summary of Slack reviews. The summary counts 1,137 mentions of notification issues. It also counts 752 mentions of information overload, where messages get buried. G2's review summary is partly machine-generated, so treat those counts as a pattern, not a measured rate.

Start with channel alerts. Mute channels that only need a weekly update, such as a marketing channel. Keep the vendor and run-of-show channels on. [How to mute a channel in Slack on Mac](/how-to/mute-a-channel-in-slack) shows the desktop steps, including a temporary mute.

Use Do Not Disturb for focus blocks. Set a pause for the hours you walk a venue or sit in a client meeting. [How to pause notifications in Slack on Mac](/how-to/pause-notifications-in-slack) covers the profile menu, schedules and the /dnd command.

blocks.title: No alerts at all?
blocks.text: If Slack sends no alerts to your Mac, check macOS first, then check Slack. The fix steps are in [how to fix Slack notifications not working on Mac](/how-to/fix-missing-notifications-in-slack).
Find the message you need when a vendor asks again

The hardest moment comes when a vendor asks about a deposit you agreed to last month. Search first. Type the vendor name or a unique word, such as a contract number, into search. Then narrow the results to the right channel or person. The full steps are in [how to search messages in Slack on Mac](/how-to/search-messages-in-slack).

Reviewers in G2's summary also say older DMs and threads are hard to find. Plan for that. [Save a message for later](/how-to/save-a-message-for-later-in-slack) when it holds a final number. [Pin a message](/how-to/pin-a-message-in-slack) for the run-of-show schedule so it stays at the top of the channel. Open [the Threads view](/how-to/open-the-threads-view-in-slack) to find replies you followed.
Turn deadlines into reminders and scheduled posts

Event work runs on deadlines. A caterer needs a headcount by Friday. A speaker needs a run sheet on Monday. Schedule a message so the update lands when vendors read it. [How to schedule a message in Slack on Mac](/how-to/schedule-a-message-in-slack) covers the steps. Set a reminder on any message you need to see again, using [how to set a reminder in Slack on Mac](/how-to/set-a-reminder-in-slack).

Your status helps too. Set a status such as On site at the venue, back after lunch, so vendors know when to expect an answer. [How to set your status in Slack on Mac](/how-to/set-your-status-in-slack) shows the desktop steps, the schedule option and the shortcut.
What Lazur does in Slack, and what it does not do

Lazur is a voice assistant for the Mac that lives in the notch. Hold ⌥ ⌘ to ask about anything on screen, including a Slack thread. Lazur sees your screen while you hold the shortcut, points at things and answers out loud. Ask where the Task Tracker is, and Lazur draws a circle and a label around it.

Lazur does not click buttons or operate Slack for you. Ask how to do something, and it guides you one click at a time. It waits for each click before it names the next one. Lazur is not a plugin or add-in for Slack. It is a separate Mac app that runs next to Slack.

Hold fn to dictate. Dictation writes clean text at the cursor in any app, so a vendor reply can start as speech. Lazur can also draft a message for you to read first. Check every draft before you send it, because the words go out under your name.

Privacy works like this. Lazur listens and looks at the screen only while you hold the shortcut. Audio and the screenshot go to AI providers to answer you, and they are not stored. Content is never used to train AI models. Lazur runs on macOS, on Apple silicon and Intel. Windows is planned, not available. Plans are on the [pricing page](/pricing), and the app is on the [download page](/download).
A weekly Slack routine for event planners

items: Monday: open the Task Tracker in each event channel and sort by due date.
Tuesday: answer every vendor thread that is still open from last week.
Midweek: check the Event Overview for changes to the venue, speakers or agenda.
Friday: post a short status in the main channel, then pin it.
Weekly: clear the reminders you finished and mute any channel that went quiet.

blocks.text: The template suggests prep, execution and wrap-up stages, with a weekly review. This routine borrows that idea. Keep it short. A quick review each week beats a long cleanup right before the event.
Mistakes event planners make in Slack

items: One channel for every event and every vendor. Split by event first, then use threads for each vendor.
Final decisions made in DMs. Move the decision into the channel, so the team and the vendor both see it.
Tasks with no due date. A task without a date sits in the tracker and never gets done.
Trusting Free history. Free keeps only 90 days, so older vendor threads may be out of reach.
Muting everything. You then miss the vendor who changes the load-in time.

blocks.text: How much time goes to work about work

Asana says knowledge workers spend 60% of their time on work about work. That means status updates, chasing answers and hunting for files, not the main job. The figure comes from Asana's Anatomy of Work Index, which surveyed over 10,000 knowledge workers. The page gives no publication year. I found no study of event planners on Slack, so treat the number as a rough guide.
What Slack costs and when to upgrade

Free works for one small event. It keeps 90 days of history, allows 10 app installations and blocks new Workflow Builder workflows. Pro costs $7.25 per user per month billed annually, or $8.75 monthly. Business+ costs $15 per user per month billed annually, or $18 monthly. Enterprise+ lists $45 annually, and you contact sales for it.

The pricing page shows a 50% promotion. It applies to monthly billing only, and only if you buy within 7 days of creating the team. It runs for the first 3 months. It does not apply to annual plans. Promo terms change, so check the live pricing page before you buy.

blocks.title: Verify before you budget
blocks.text: These figures come from Slack's pricing page, as summarized in my research notes. Check Slack's live pricing page before you put numbers in a budget.
Mac checks before event week

items: Check your Slack version against the release notes page. The newest Mac build is 4.53.283, a bug-fix release.
Open System Settings > Notifications, then confirm that Slack can send alerts.
Confirm your plan. The Free plan has limits on history, apps and workflows.
Build one practice channel from the template and test it before a real event.
Press ⌘K and ⌘/ once each, so they feel normal when you are in a rush.

blocks.text: Next steps for your first event

Start with one event. Create a channel with [how to create a channel in Slack on Mac](/how-to/create-a-channel-in-slack), add the template and fill in the Event Overview on day one. Run the weekly routine for a few weeks before you add more events. If you want a voice helper while you work, [download Lazur](/download) and hold ⌥ ⌘ when you need an answer.

faq.question: Does Slack have an event planning template?
faq.answer: Yes. Slack's event planning template adds a preconfigured channel with an Event Overview tab, a Task Tracker tab and an item status notifications workflow. Get it from Slack's template page, then follow the setup steps on this page.

faq.question: Where do I find workflow templates in Slack on Mac?
faq.answer: Click Agents & tools in the sidebar, then under Workflows click Templates. Some users see a Tools tab instead. If the item is hidden, look for the Tools tab and click More.

faq.question: Can Slack track event budgets?
faq.answer: Not with a dedicated budget tab. Slack's template asks you to log vendor and budget items in the Event Overview and the Task Tracker. For a large budget, keep a spreadsheet and link it from the channel.

faq.question: Can Lazur set up the Slack template for me?
faq.answer: No. Lazur does not click buttons or operate Slack for you. Ask Lazur to walk you through each step. It guides you one click at a time and waits for each click.

faq.question: Is Slack free for event planners?
faq.answer: The Free plan works for a single small event. It keeps 90 days of message and file history, allows 10 app installations and blocks new Workflow Builder workflows. Check Slack's plans page before a bigger event.

faq.question: Can I invite vendors into Slack on the Free plan?
faq.answer: Free Slack Connect is limited to one-to-one work with external partners in DMs. A group vendor channel needs a paid plan. Check Slack's plan table for current details before you invite a whole vendor list.

faq.question: Does Lazur work on Windows?
faq.answer: Not yet. Lazur runs on macOS, on Apple silicon and Intel Macs. Windows is planned, not available.

faq.question: Does Lazur read my Slack messages?
faq.answer: Lazur listens and looks at the screen only while you hold the shortcut. Audio and the screenshot go to AI providers to answer you and are not stored. Content is never used to train AI models.
